description:
Twilight Sparkle and Starlight Glimmer both think they have it harder, so they decide to settle the argument by switching bodies for an hour. But what starts as a harmless bet quickly turns deadly when Starlight, trapped in Twilight's body, is thrown into a life or death battle with one of Twilight's enemies. Meanwhile, Twilight herself fights for her own life on the south side of Ponyville against a handful of Ponyville's most dangerous apex predators...
